rationale: C03 is a highly plausible drafting template: it is an Eisenhower resignation-acceptance letter issued only weeks earlier and follows the same material sequence—reluctant acceptance compelled by the departing official's stated reasons, praise tied to a demanding government office, review of service extending through the World War II era, recognition of contributions to governmental efficiency or management, and warm wishes for the future. C23 has a similar retirement-letter structure and several matching themes, but its language and organization are less closely aligned. C05 is another relevant Eisenhower resignation letter, though its substantive praise focuses more narrowly on departmental policy and offers a weaker structural match.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is with a great deal of regret that I agree to the request in your [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE]
shared_material.parent_excerpt: it is only with the greatest reluctance that I accept your resignation as Director of the Bureau of the Budget
shared_material.explanation: Both open by reluctantly accepting an official's requested departure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: after thirteen and one-half years of outstanding service in that important position
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your services during these past fourteen months in office have been invaluable to the country
shared_material.explanation: Both immediately quantify the tenure and praise the value of service in a difficult senior governmental position.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the period of tremendous responsibility in government incident to the conduct of the second World War
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the governmental positions you have been called to fill since the beginning of World War II
shared_material.explanation: Both situate the departing official's record against government responsibilities beginning with World War II.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a lasting mark on government in the great program of the General Accounting Office ... better, more efficient governmental operation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: your reputation for .efficiency and dedication to the public good has continued to grow
shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize efficiency and a durable contribution to public administration.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Please accept my warm good wishes for a fully satisfying and happy retirement.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: wishing for you the greatest of happiness and success in the years to come. With warm personal regard
shared_material.explanation: Both close with warm wishes for happiness after government service.
